integrity.finite_computation_role: Stress-testing only; the proof is symbolic and valid for all n and k in range.
integrity.new_argument: Coefficientwise refinement of Jordan-block partitions plus an explicit complex-symmetric size-two nilpotent block.
integrity.non_elementary_input: Friedman--Hoşten--Rosana Theorem 3.5 and their identification of the ED discriminant.

scientific_limitations: The count is set-theoretic and does not determine critical-scheme multiplicities.
Sharp finite discriminant examples are complex symmetric; real symmetric discriminant data have infinite critical sets.
The result concerns the full projection Grassmannian rather than arbitrary subvarieties.
title: A sharp finite-critical-point gap on the Grassmannian ED discriminant
